A routine land survey has revealed that the soil quality on [This.GetName] has drastically improved in recent years across large swathes of the planet.

We believe that many areas once thought incapable of supporting agriculture can now be used to expand our farming efforts.

summary.text:
# [This.GetNewfoundFertilityTitle] / [This.GetNewfoundFertilityTitle]

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5749-5789`; `events/shroud_events.txt:645-760,961-1221`; `common/scripted_variables/09_scripted_variables_shroud.txt:43`; `events/shroud_events.txt:1373-1449`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

迷信者（Superstitious Beliefs）文明的周期事件触发：每个13年周期开始（首个周期除外）掷出吉或凶（shroud.210/220/230 → 410/415，events/shroud_events.txt:961-1221），再从 on_action 的16个等权事件中抽取一个（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5749-5789）；本事件每个帝国至多一次（国家旗标 shroud_510_triggered）。吉兆事件。非游牧；拥有盖亚/海洋星球（安格勒斯文明除外）或有农业区划的行星。分流事件 shroud.510 → 512。

Triggered by the cycles of a Superstitious Beliefs empire: each 13-year cycle (except the first) rolls good or bad luck (shroud.210/220/230 → 410/415, events/shroud_events.txt:961-1221) and one of the 16 equally weighted events of that on_action is drawn (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5749-5789); this event happens at most once per empire (country flag shroud_510_triggered). A good luck event. Non-nomad; owns a Gaia/Ocean planet (Anglers exempt) or a planet with a farming district. Router shroud.510 → 512.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单窗口通知，无后续剧情；唯一的选项直接生效。唯一选项：该星球获得“肥沃土地”矿藏 d_fertile_lands；安格勒斯“新生肥沃”则改为 lush_planet 修正。

A single notification window with no continuation; its only option applies directly. Only option: the planet gains the d_fertile_lands deposit; for the Anglers "newfound fertility" variant it gets the lush_planet modifier instead.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无分支；与同一抽取池中另外15个事件互不相关，各自独立成卡。

No branching; independent of the other 15 events of the same draw pool, each shown as its own card.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

标题与正文有两种（安格勒斯 / 其他），标题为脚本本地化 [GetNewfoundFertilityTitle]。

Title and text have two variants (Anglers / others); the title is the scripted loc [GetNewfoundFertilityTitle].

## 审阅记录 Review notes

对照脚本核实了触发条件、旗标、选项效果和本地化；触发链（周期→吉凶掷骰→on_action）已核对。

Trigger, flag, option effects and localisation were checked against the script; the trigger chain (cycle → luck roll → on_action) was verified.
